description: Unharnessed, unloaded, unled — and still keeping to its route. Get in the way and it comes on at a walk.
lore: In the life it fell out of, somebody owned it. That is worth knowing, because of what comes off one: a bronze camp knife, hemp rope chewed to a splay, three iron links worn smooth on the inside by years of harness, a roll of coarse grey canvas. One person's kit for going somewhere and stopping for the night, all of it still coming off an animal that is carrying nothing at all.

It keeps a route. It comes on at a walk, in a line, and the line does not bend around you, because you are standing in a road it was walking before the road went soft. [[characters/7a779de1|Wendell]] swears the line is the old east road, and for an evening's company he will name you every stop on it — which is one more thing than the animal can do.

The load went. The voice up at the front went so long ago there is no name left to put to it. Now and then it halts in open ground, swings both ears forward at nothing whatever, waits to be spoken to, and then walks on.
